newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian copper prices fall on easing world markets.
newsitem.headline: Indian copper prices fall on easing world markets.

text.p: Indian copper prices fell on Thursday on reports of easing world markets while other metals were steady in limited trade, dealers said.
Ready copper fell by 50 rupees to 11,950 rupees per quintal.
Nickel was steady at 39,400 rupees on stray physical support, after falling by 200 rupees on Wednesday.
Tin, zinc and lead were unchanged from previous levels.
"Aluminium was steady at 7,450 rupees but sentiment was weak on reports that aluminium prices in the world market has fallen to a two-year low," one dealer said.
